title: Flow Graph Navbar Toggle Theming
description: Flow nodes/handles/edges must match navbar toggle theming: element gray default, hover fill + emphasized content, selected primary fill + emphasized stroke/text.
summary: Fixed sketchpad virtual file system default theming: Table rows now use text-element at rest with hover:bg-hover-interactive-fill + hover:text-emphasized and selected bg-active-base text-emphasized via shared tableRowInteractiveClass/tableRowSelectedClass. VFS node glyphs no longer force text-muted-foreground; expand chevron uses element gray + hover emphasis. Platform BuiltinVirtualFileSystemKindRenderer programmatic hover uses bg-hover-interactive-fill text-emphasized instead of bg-hover-temporary. Vitest: VirtualFileSystem expand affordance test asserts text-element and no muted-foreground on rows.
